cases.sql: PREPARE collated_parameter(text) AS SELECT ($1 COLLATE "C") COLLATE "POSIX" AS value; EXECUTE collated_parameter('prepared'); DEALLOCATE collated_parameter
CREATE FUNCTION "COLLATE"(text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE SQL VOLATILE AS $$SELECT 'routine'::text$$; SELECT "COLLATE"('x') AS routine_value, 'x' COLLATE "C" AS clause_value

CREATE TABLE collated_values (source text, copied text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (source COLLATE "C") STORED, virtual_copy text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (source COLLATE "POSIX") VIRTUAL, defaulted text DEFAULT ('default' COLLATE "C"))
CREATE VIEW collated_view AS SELECT source COLLATE "C" AS value FROM collated_values
BEGIN; UPDATE collated_values SET source='changed'; SELECT source,copied,virtual_copy,defaulted FROM collated_values ORDER BY source; ROLLBACK
SELECT source,copied,virtual_copy,defaulted FROM collated_values ORDER BY source
SELECT value FROM collated_view ORDER BY value
